title: H06回到H15唯一训练启动前：恢复无训练状态，已用机会不返还
availability_guard: Only an originally legal H06/H15 match and target snapshot, original10-second/current-not-in-check/preflight/same-body nonattack noncheck replay and existing barriers satisfied. Target S predates the unique successful H15 start; at S no training ever started. Since S this start succeeded, same trainee is still alive/actively training/ungraduated at restore. No intervening death/failure/graduation, H11 barrier or unresolved binding/control transformation.
source_facts: Historical §9.14 explicitly restores snapshot trainee/progress/lifecycle authority state; snapshot without training has no earlier trainee or cultivation to restore.
Later three-mode core explicitly prevents already-used training opportunity becoming unused through H06.
No later retrieved source explicitly makes a newly started active training relation persist when target snapshot predates its start.
Current1.57 approval only covers actual pregraduation death-failure with earlier active-training snapshot; does not approve this branch.
proposal: 合法H06回到启动前快照S时，H15训练关系随快照恢复为尚无训练：不保留后来秘密绑定、培养进度或后续培养资格；棋子依S正常恢复，本条不将它视为死亡。
本局唯一训练机会仍为已用；不能再次选种、随机征募或启动，不因重走原先回合而返还机会。
已共同知道的成功启动事实、选定兵种和机会已用仍依已确认展示及记忆规则保留；不新增实时有效/失败状态或实际进度提示。
回溯及重走本身不触发H15培养；无训练关系时，未来己方正常begin也不继续这次已被回溯撤销的训练。
rationale: 推荐按快照恢复训练关系，仅保留已有明确非回溯例外（机会已用）；避免另增一个将未来训练带回过去的例外。此为组合判断及具体候选，不冒充新增原始用户确认。

alternative.description: 保留启动后持续有效的训练关系与当下培养进度，虽S早于启动。
alternative.tradeoff: 需要再定义训练关系/进度不随快照恢复的额外例外；不能由唯一机会不返还自动推出，也不能混用持续训练的原9.14条款。

counterexample_boundaries.result: 不是本候选；已确认1.57失败例外继续有效。

counterexample_boundaries.result: 不凭回溯制造一次已用；启动资格按原来源处理。

counterexample_boundaries.result: 不改变原棋盘/训练/资源；不是已成功恢复S的分支。

counterexample_boundaries.case: S后已毕业、飞行消失、已死亡或跨H11等
counterexample_boundaries.result: 不适用此最小候选，仍按各自确认/待核分支，不套用本候选。
